pet_kindle_safe.name: Kindle
pet_kindle_safe.desc: Kindle, the ember salamander (Cinderhold companion, ~0.5x player): charcoal-red hide, amber belly, a gold scarf, red-gold back spots that pulse like coals and a glowing coal at the tail tip; curls into a coal when she faints

petfx.look: NEON red glow spots / tail coal in kindle_neon.png (primary); kindle.png is palette-safe (lamp / flower_gold / white coals), same layout

pet_kindle_safe.story: muspelheim.md 5.4: companion (befriend); ember_dash, warm_ring; lights torches; faint = curls into a coal, returns at the waystone
